description: This file contains the PHP class 'Map' within the namespace 'Opencart.Admin.Model.Extension.Opencart.Dashboard', which extends the system engine model class. It primarily provides a method to retrieve total orders grouped by country, involving configuration checks, database queries, and return of structured data.

classes.name: Map
classes.description: A model class for handling dashboard map data related to orders by country within the OpenCart admin extension namespace.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByCountry
methods.description: Fetches the total number of orders and sum of their amounts grouped by country, based on configured order statuses.
